leaf_morphology.secondary_veins: distinct and clearly raised, closely spaced, approximately 12–20 pairs per leaf, each slightly arching toward and terminating at the serrated margin

traits.notes: Leaves appear clustered in a pseudo-whorl at the upper node (several leaves radiating from a single point); blades narrowly elliptic with sharp serrations along the margin (regular, forward-pointing teeth); midrib strongly raised on the lower surface (conspicuous central vein); some leaves show margin missing and small holes present (localized loss of lamina tissue); seedling stem upright and relatively slender (single vertical main stem visible).
